personnel: Joe Venuti (violin), Eddie Lang (guitar)
trivia: Joe Venuti and Eddie Lang are credited with pioneering strings in jazz, and this Columbia duet came before their OKeh series. Their duo was a studio duo for much of the late 1920s.

Release year 1927 is inferred from the Columbia catalogue sequence (913-D and 915-D were recorded in February 1927) and not verified.
